summary: The filing is a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 in which Palmer Square Capital BDC Inc., a business development company, discloses management's unaudited estimate of net asset value per share as of May 31, 2026, at $13.63. This is a routine periodic NAV estimate, not a special situation event. There are no merger, tender, activism, restructuring, or corporate action terms discussed. The filing lacks any deal mechanics, premiums, board recommendations, or strategic initiatives. It is a standard current report providing updated financial information to shareholders.
